info.name: BCS Question Backend
info.description:
Complete and standardized API Collection for BCS Question Backend.

All endpoints adhere to the standardized response envelope:
- **Success Response**: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": ... }`
- **Error Response**: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errorMessages": [{ "path": "field", "message": "..." }] }`

Tokens (`access_token`, `refresh_token`) are automatically captured and updated into Collection Variables upon running `Login`, `Verify Registration OTP`, or `Token Refresh`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication and user lifecycle endpoints (Registration, OTP verification, Login, Profile, Password management, Logout).

request.description: Register a new user account. Creates an inactive user and sends a 6-digit OTP to the registered email.

response.name: 201 Created - OTP Sent
400 Bad Request - Email Already Exists

exec: console.log('Access token and refresh token saved.');

request.description: Verify registration OTP (5-minute expiration). On success, marks the user active and verified, and automatically saves JWT access & refresh tokens to collection variables.
Resends verification OTP to an unverified user's email. Enforces a 60-second cooldown period between requests.

response.name: 200 Success - New OTP Sent
400 Bad Request - Already Verified
429 Too Many Requests - 60s Cooldown

exec: console.log('Access token and refresh token saved.');

request.description: Authenticate with email and password. Automatically stores `access_token` and `refresh_token` into collection variables upon successful login.

response.name: 403 Forbidden - Email Unverified

request.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a fresh access token using the standardized response format. Automatically updates `access_token`.

response.name: 401 Unauthorized - Invalid Refresh Token

request.description: Fetch user details of the currently authenticated user using JWT access token.

response.name: 401 Unauthorized - Missing / Invalid Token

request.description: Change account password for the logged-in user. Supports `current_password` (or `old_password`), `new_password` (min length 6), and optional `confirm_password`.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Incorrect Current Password
400 Bad Request - Passwords Do Not Match
400 Bad Request - Same As Current Password

request.description: Log out authenticated user and blacklist the refresh token. Clears collection variables upon success.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Invalid or Expired Token

item.name: Password Reset
item.description: Password reset flow using email OTP verification (Forgot Password -> Verify Reset OTP -> Reset Password).

request.description: Request a password reset OTP sent to the user's email address. Enforces a 60-second cooldown period.

response.name: 200 Success - OTP Sent
429 Too Many Requests - 60s Cooldown

request.description: Verify password reset OTP before setting a new password (5-minute expiration).
Set a new password using email, verified OTP code, and new_password (min length 6).
